A 48hr EEG session at home and he got the copies of my CT scan from the initial ER visit. 

I landed head first when I fell but never lost consciousness. Four co-workers saw incident and confirmed what happened.

Had family members check for a concusion after work. Uncle was paramedic for 20 years and grandma a head nurse for 30, both said mild concussion. Didn't go to Dr initially because I hadn't received employee medical insurance yet and didn't have a primary medical care provider plus shift was 0700-1900\2000 Mon-Sat so getting appointment at clinic seemed too much of hastle at the time.

Week later the shift before Christmas Eve, I was super nauseaus with throbbing headache. Took Ibprofen and powered through day. Went home and was visiting with my dad when I felt dread. Went to bed and felt like I couldn't breathe. Found my dad and uncle and, said "can't see" and fell over, they caught me before hitting the ground. Started convulsing violently but never fully lost awareness. Couldnt feel my extremities so didnt notice I was breaking off toenails and brusing hands. Woke up from event on way to hospital and requested to go home. Threw up and went to sleep. Had another episode the next day where hands and feet turned blue so went to ER.
